original_id.Description: Original animal ID in the experimenter's records

body_weight_g.Description: Body weight at time of injection

cage.Description: Home cage ID (animals sharing a cage were cage-mates)

staining_batch.Description: Immunostaining batch number (1–4); batch is a covariate

chronic.Description: Received repeated daily injections prior to acute injection

acute.Description: Received an acute challenge injection before perfusion

spontaneous_withdrawal.Description: Perfused during spontaneous withdrawal (no final challenge)
